text: The Patriots head into Sunday's 1 PM ET home opener against the Steelers at Gillette Stadium facing a significant challenge with A.J. Brown sidelined for at least four games after suffering a high ankle sprain in Week 1, forcing the offense to adjust and other receivers to step up in his absence as Mike Reiss examines who'll fill that void in the Patriots' passing attack. Drake Maye and the Patriots will look to bounce back from their Week 1 performance against a Steelers defense eager to establish a blueprint against New England's offensive scheme in what shapes up as a compelling chess match between two teams seeking early momentum. Off the field, Patriots owner Robert Kraft made headlines this week by having Macklemore removed as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's upcoming shows at Gillette Stadium, citing concerns over what he characterized as a "history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery," while Maye himself drew praise for his community impact—he and his wife Ann Michael paid for the Amazon classroom wish lists of more than 50 teachers and support specialists at Alfred Lima Sr. Elementary School in Providence.
